Connect Engagement to Revenue Drivers
 
 
 
 
 
Act-On enables you to connect your engagement programs to key revenue drivers across the entire lifecycle —like buying intent, cross-sell triggers and churn intent signals.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Improve Sales Marketing Alignment Pre and Post sale
 
 
 
 
 
Act-On aligns marketing programs with customer-facing teams high touch engagement so the customer experience is seamless and coordinated
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Leverage Your Customer Data Wherever It Lives
 
 
 
 
 With Act-On, the choice of a CRM is yours. Act-On natively plugs into your stack as the intelligent engagement layer, activating your data wherever it lives.

Frequently Asked Questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What is Act-On’s marketing automation platform?
 
 
 
Act-On is a lifecycle marketing automation platform that accelerates revenue growth by empowering businesses to engage prospects and customers across email, web, SMS, social media, and other channels through highly personalized 1:1 journeys driven by intelligent automation.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How is Act-On different from traditional marketing automation platforms?
 
 
 
Act-On differs from traditional marketing automation platforms like Marketo, Hubspot, Pardot, and Eloqua by combining the best of marketing automation and customer engagement platform capabilities found in Braze and Iterable offering robust engagement capabilities across the entire customer lifecycle.
Act-On is different in several key ways:
Lifecycle-focused, not just lead generation.
 Act-On helps marketers grow revenue through lifecycle marketing. Unlike traditional platforms that are largely geared toward lead generation, Act-On provides the flexibility to automate and optimize campaigns at every stage—from awareness to advocacy.
Scalable personalization.
 Act-On enables highly personalized journeys that build lasting relationships. While many platforms rely on limited contact data, Act-On allows marketers to design journeys based on product usage, account data, support tickets, and other insights that reflect long-term customer relationships.
Built for an open ecosystem—not a CRM add-on.
 Many marketing automation tools are part of all-in-one platforms that don’t integrate well with other vendors. Act-On is a standalone platform designed to work seamlessly within an open marketing ecosystem.
Powerful, yet easy to use.
 Act-On balances advanced capabilities with ease of use, enabling marketers to build and launch automated campaigns without extensive training or outside support.
AI that supports marketers—not replaces them.
 Act-On’s AI is designed to enhance human creativity and decision-making, delivering fast, accurate insights that help optimize campaign performance.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What type of company is Act-On designed for?
 
 
 
Act-On serves marketing teams in midsize and enterprise organizations that are focused on growing revenue from new and existing customers through lifecycle marketing. It’s the perfect fit for teams that want advanced lifecycle orchestration capabilities in an approachable UX that allows non-technical marketers to build and deploy campaigns quickly. Act-On is proud to serve marketers in leading global companies across financial services, manufacturing, professional services, technology, and many other 
industries
.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Does Act-On serve distributed marketing models like branch offices and franchises?
 
 
 
Yes!  Act-On helps brands scale marketing by enabling corporate teams to deliver ready-to-use campaigns to franchisees, branch offices, agents and partners. Corporate marketers can centrally create and distribute pre-built content templates and automated programs, allowing individual locations to launch campaigns quickly without needing deep marketing expertise.
Companies benefit from an easy-to-use platform that ensures brand consistency while allowing for local customization. This approach increases campaign speed, improves engagement, while maintaining control over brand standards across all locations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What channels can I manage using Act-On?
 
 
 
Act-On helps marketers run automated 
multi-channel marketing
 campaigns across email, web, SMS, social media, direct mail, and more. Its lifecycle orchestration capabilities ensure that marketers can drive intelligent automation and 1:1 personalization across these channels, and generate the insights required to continuously optimize engagement across them.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How does Act-On use AI in marketing automation?
 
 
 
Act-On AI empowers marketers to work faster and smarter across the entire customer lifecycle.
InSite web agent
 uses AI to provide personalized answers to website visitors and captures the interests and intent of known contacts.
Predictive lead scoring
 identifies high-quality leads based on historical engagement patterns.
True Open
 identifies email clicks and opens generated by security and privacy bots, providing marketers with more accurate reporting and behavior-based automation.
Agentic data analysis
 uncovers insights and generates data visualizations through simple conversations with Act-On’s AI agent.
Adaptive Send
 determines the best time to send emails to individual contacts based on previous engagement patterns.
AI Create
 quickly generates brand-compliant marketing copy from a simple prompt.
Subject Line Optimizer
 helps marketers generate high-performing subject lines based on previous engagement data.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Does Act-On integrate with my existing MarTech stack?
 
 
 
Yes! Act-On’s success is rooted in our customers’ ability to leverage the diverse array of data sources required to orchestrate personalized journeys at every step of a lifecycle.
Our Data Bridge connector enables it to send and receive data from any API- or webhook-enabled system, including ERP, product management, financial services platforms, and more. Act-On also provides iPAAS integration with Zapier and Integrately for marketers looking to automate workflows involving more complex data triggers, transformation, and exchange.
Act-On’s integrations
 with Salesforce, Dynamics, Sugar, NetSuite, and Zendesk embeds its UI directly into your CRM platform, allowing members of other customer-facing teams to understand how a contact or account has been engaging. Bidirectional data integration enables marketers to automate and personalize outreach with CRM data, or trigger the creation of tasks, records, and objects from contact engagement with Act-On.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Does your marketing automation platform include analytics?
 
 
 
Act-On provides 
reporting and analytics
 that help marketers understand engagement and performance across the entire customer lifecycle. Its AI agent for data analysis enables users to explore and visualize cross-channel engagement through natural language queries. With CRM integration, marketers can connect engagement to revenue using attribution reporting, funnel velocity, and lead source analysis.
Users can pin key reports and charts to custom dashboards for quick access or automatically share reports with stakeholders by email.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Is Act-On easy for marketing teams to use?
 
 
 
Yes, Act-On is designed to be easy for marketing teams to use while still providing powerful capabilities. It enables marketers to build and launch automated campaigns, analyze performance, and optimize results without extensive training or technical expertise.
Act-On combines an intuitive interface with powerful tools for building personalized customer journeys. Features like AI-powered content creation, natural language data analysis, and automated reporting help marketers work faster and make smarter decisions without relying on developers or outside support.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How is Act-On’s marketing automation software priced?
 
 
 
Act-On’s pricing model
 is based on the number of contacts emailed each month. This keeps pricing aligned with actual usage and allows teams to store and collect inbound data (email clicks, website visits, form submissions, etc.) for an unlimited number of contacts in their database.

Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
 
 
Everything you need to know about the product and billing.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What is an "Active Contact"?
 
 
 
Active Contacts are based on the number of contacts you engage within a given month — not the size of your database. Your database might include millions of contacts, but you might include only 50% of them in your campaigns. Act-On pricing is based on the volume of active contacts rather than the sum number in your marketing database.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What if I need to adjust my number of Active Contacts?
 
 
 
We understand that many businesses experience cyclical or unpredictable growth throughout the year. Our pricing model is intentionally flexible to scale with your needs all year long, allowing for variance in Active Contact fees to meet your business realities.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How is my pricing determined?
 
 
 
The calculator above provides a pricing range for the Act-On Platform. Anticipated pricing starts at the figure shown, yet actual pricing may vary depending on additional factors – including add-ons, configuration, and implementation. Please contact sales for a specific quote unique to your needs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What will my pricing be next year?
 
 
 
The calculator above provides a pricing range for the Act-On Platform. Anticipated pricing starts at the figure shown, yet actual pricing may vary depending on additional factors – including add-ons, configuration, and implementation. Please contact sales for a specific quote unique to your needs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I purchase add-on functionality?
 
 
 
The majority of the additional product functionality included in the Enterprise package is available to those with the Professional package for a fee. Please contact us for details.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Am I required to sign an annual contract?
 
 
 
Yes. Your long-term success is our priority, and we find that customers that commit to the year-long investment (or beyond) are most successful with our platform.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Do you offer discounts for 501 © (3) non-profits?
 
 
 
Yes. Please contact us for details.
